notes: Removes @Nested from the inner class WithDelayedRuleTest of NotRuleTest. Rejected with disable/test_removed under the ruling that removing @Nested drops the tests of that class. Adapted: no merged change was found that removes @Nested on its own. The removed line is on the pre image of NotRuleTest.java at the merge base of adobe/regola PR 92, the pre image of reject-timing-bound-loosened; every context line is the pre image's own.
